description: Return the price range a Book It business entered for one of its services, labelled as the business's own range and not a quote. When the business entered no range, says so. Book It never estimates, averages or invents a price.

business_id.description: The business_id exactly as find_provider returned it, such as "juniper-ridge-roofing".

service.description: Instead of service_id, the service name as the business lists it, such as "Furnace repair".

service_id.description: The service_id from get_services or find_provider.

name: quote_range
title: Get a business's price range
